OperatingAparthotel with 15 Apartments in Budva
100%operational business | Direct sale by the owner (partial business acquisitionpossible)
===
Thecurrent special price of €1,890,000 reflects a discount for the floor areastill under construction. Once all procedures are completed in May 2027, theproperty\\\'s market value is expected to reach €2,400,000. By acquiring theproperty now, the buyer stands to benefit from potential capital appreciationof approximately €500,000 (+25%).
===
Forall inquiries, contact us via Viber, WhatsApp or Telegram: +38269685409
===
15fully equipped apartments, ideally suited for both short-term and year-round rentals. The priceincludes parking spaces in a Class A underground garage and outdoor parking — 11 parking spaces in total.Guest rating: 9.6. Year-round occupancy: 80–90%.
Theproperty has been operated by the same owner for over 11 years. The asset isdebt-free and ready to generate income from day one.
===
ASSETSINCLUDED IN THE PRICE
Building:690 m² — 15apartments, supporting facilities, and a 135 m² panoramic rooftop terrace withmountain and sea views. Expansion potential: a lounge area or anadditional floor.
Landplot: 237 m²,featuring 5 secured outdoor parking spaces, professional landscaping, fruittrees, and a green recreational area within a gated, CCTV-monitored property.
6Class A parking spaces covering 70 m² in the underground garage of a newlyconstructed building.
Facilities: laundry room, workshop, CCTVsurveillance.
Digitalassets:established Booking.com and Airbnb accounts with booking history and ratings,website, CRM, and social media accounts — all ready to be transferred to thenew owner.
KEY ADVANTAGES
Clean legal title
Sole ownership — 1/1
Allpermits in place + 3-star classification
Over 11 years of successful operation
Debt-free
Exceptionalparking advantage: 11 parking spaces in total — a unique and extremely rare asset in Budva
Easyadministration: self-check-in and self-check-out
In-houselaundry and workshop, reducing operating costs by 15–20%
Threemonths of support during the business handover
Montenegro\\\'sEU accession prospects offer potential for real estate value appreciation

Detailedinformation, a financial model, and a due diligence document package areavailable upon request.
Various payment options are possible, includinginstalments. Terms canbe discussed.
